description: Contrast and motion (CLAUDE.md states dark-mode support): Color.mist footnote on white 2.46:1; Moss link (no dark variant) on black 3.29:1 in dark mode; white label on the Apricot fill 2.07:1; an overdue/on-time dot shown only by colour; a repeatForever pulse with no Reduce Motion check. Decoys: a 28 pt title in Color.slate (3.95:1 white, 5.32:1 black, passes the large-text bar); Ink text both ways; a seal icon with a Finished label; a repeating spin gated on accessibilityReduceMotion; a one-shot spring on tap; a Plum-tinted borderedProminent button. Also must_find (P2, added 2026-10-22): the seal symbol beside 'Finished' is read aloud.
prompt: Do the accessibility pass on this app's screens and report your findings.

must_find.why: Color.mist on white is 2.46:1, below 4.5:1 for footnote text.
Moss has no dark value; on the dark background it is 3.29:1.
White 17 pt Semibold on Apricot is 2.07:1.
Overdue vs on time is shown only by the dot's colour.
repeatForever pulse with no accessibilityReduceMotion check.

The seal symbol has no .accessibilityHidden(true) and sits beside a 'Finished' Text that says the same thing: a decorative image read aloud (P2). Added 2026-10-22 after 3/3 runs reported it and the evaluator adjudicated it legitimate; EVALUATOR-WRITTEN, review.

must_not_flag.why: Ink passes in light and dark.
The state has a text label. (A color-only finding here is scored as a wrong-category hit on seal-read-aloud, since must_find wins on overlap.)
The repeating spin is removed under Reduce Motion.
One-shot animation in response to a tap.
